0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-1, 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, 8th in the West) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, 1st in the Northwest, 2nd in the West), with Phoenix holding a 0-1 road record and a one-game winning streak. Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and is a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is missing Jalen Williams (ankle), Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery), and Cason Wallace (shoulder) and Jaylin Williams (wrist soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, the Suns lost 2-3 to the Thunder in 2025-26 and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, and their last meeting was a 131-122 Oklahoma City win in Phoenix on April 27.
